result.markdown:
For Newcastle, NSW, and the Hunter Region, I’d shortlist consultancies based on how well they can build **operational apps for warehouse, shop-floor and field workers**—not simply how much Microsoft 365 or Power BI consulting they offer.

The strongest fit is a team that can combine Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and integration with your existing ERP or inventory systems. The aim is to replace paper forms, spreadsheets and manual handoffs with reliable, mobile-friendly workflows.

## My shortlist

(Strong Power Apps fit)

Report Simple explicitly markets Power Apps consulting for Newcastle, including custom canvas and model-driven apps, industrial workflows, process automation and integration with SQL, SharePoint and Dynamics 365. Its published offer is closely aligned with replacing spreadsheet-based operational processes. [www.reportsimple.com.au](https://www.reportsimple.com.au/consulting/power-apps-consulting-newcastle?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** custom operational forms, field-to-office data capture, inspections and workflow digitisation.

## 5\. SSW Newcastle

SSW has a Newcastle office at 432 Hunter Street and a strong Microsoft-oriented software engineering background. It is a useful candidate if your requirements go beyond standard low-code apps and involve custom integrations, complex application logic or a broader software architecture. Confirm the proposed team’s hands-on Dataverse experience before shortlisting. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ0SvNDd4Vc2sRo6TTabCULts&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** technically complex solutions where low-code development may need to be combined with custom software.

[Website — SSW](https://www.ssw.com.au/)

## Who I would contact first

| Your priority | First choice | Alternative |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Local Newcastle/Hunter presence and site visits | Team10 | Cloudhunter |
| Explicit Newcastle Power Apps development | Report Simple | Inturing |
| Warehouse/shop-floor apps with Dataverse and ERP integration | Inturing | Report Simple |
| Complex custom engineering and integrations | SSW Newcastle | Cloudhunter |


This is a **fit-based shortlist, not an independently verified ranking**\. The published information I found does not establish which provider has the strongest track record specifically in warehouse execution, manufacturing shop-floor systems or field-service deployments.

## What to ask before selecting a consultant

For your use case, I would ask each provider to demonstrate a relevant implementation and answer these five questions\:

1. **Dataverse architecture\:** Can you design proper tables, relationships, role-based security and audit history rather than building everything around SharePoint lists?
2. **Frontline usability\:** Can the app run well on rugged tablets and phones, including barcode scanning, and offline capture where required?
3. **Operational workflows\:** Have you delivered goods receiving, stock movements, production checks, maintenance work orders, inspections or field-service reporting?
4. **Integration\:** Can you connect the app to our ERP, inventory, finance or manufacturing systems without creating duplicate records?
5. **Ownership and support\:** Will the solution live in our Microsoft tenant, with documented flows, deployment practices, licensing costs and a clear support arrangement?

For a warehouse or shop-floor solution, I would prioritise a working demonstration using one of your actual processes over a generic Power Apps portfolio.

## My recommendation

Start with **Report Simple and Inturing** for the technical fit, and **Team10** if having a Newcastle-based partner who can work directly with your operations team is particularly important.
